text: Used as subcategory of Mind-Body Medicine in CAM.  This area deals with the non-behavioral aspects of spirituality and religion that examine their relationship to biological function or clinical conditions.  It included activities such as prayer, soul retrieval, spiritual healing, Included are: Prayer, Confession, Nonlocality, Nontemporality, Consciousness studies, Spirituality constructs (Love, hope, faith, joy, etc.), Soul retrieval (see Indigenous practices), Spiritual healing, "Special" healers (see "Biofield").
